narration: You own a resort in Zanzibar, but this week you are away. Was a rate changed? Was a bill voided? With Operra, every folio change is logged, and the reports are on your phone. You see what happened, without calling anyone.

scenes.line: Away from your resort this week?
scenes.image: A narrow old-town street at golden hour with coral-stone walls and a carved brass-studded wooden door, a resort owner seen from behind walking with a travel bag. Warm light, cinematic photograph.
A business traveller seen from behind at a hotel window at dusk, harbour lights below, holding a cup of coffee, soft focus, cinematic photograph.
A beach resort pool at dusk with lanterns and palm trees, calm and empty, cinematic photograph.
A resort owner seen from behind on a balcony at sunset with a view over a turquoise lagoon and a dhow with a lateen sail, relaxed, cinematic photograph.
